directiveLines: Use Material 3 components and a Scaffold-based layout structure.
Prefer bottom navigation for top-level navigation on mobile.

fab.name: fab
fab.description: Floating action button for the primary action

scaffold.name: scaffold
scaffold.description: App-level layout skeleton wrapping the page

conventions: Top-level nav maps to bottom NavigationBar; secondary nav maps to a NavigationDrawer.
FAB for the single primary action of a screen.
